purpose: Freeze development-only comparator execution choices before any F08 pilot and preserve the F02 causal estimand firewall.

source_binding.stream_key_algorithm: first 64 bits (16 lowercase hex) of SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 DT-P9-v1|DEV|<scenario>|r=<two-digit realisation>
source_binding.immutable_source_rule: Comparators consume the exact same two-tape DEV source identity used by F02/F05; no comparator-specific stream regeneration.

rolling_cart.initial_fit: last 2000 revealed rows available before the first scored post-prefix prediction
rolling_cart.refit_timing: after current prediction, label reveal and scoring; include the just-revealed row only after it has been scored
rolling_cart.constructor: same scikit-learn 1.9.0 DecisionTreeClassifier constructor as FROZEN_CART
rolling_cart.selection_basis: prospective structural alignment, not DEV score optimisation
justification: window equals the study initialisation size
window equals the declared gradual-drift width
refit cadence equals the internal learner selection/update interval

seed_policy.comparator_seed_schedule: working/f07/COMPARATOR_SEED_FREEZE.json plus canonical regeneration by f07_dev_contract.py
seed_policy.algorithm: first 32 bits (8 lowercase hex) of SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 DT-P9-v1|DEV|COMPARATOR|<method>|stream=<stream_key_hex>

f08_pilot.purpose: correctness, timing, source identity, runtime qualification and resource feasibility only
f08_pilot.plastic: add only after the separate official-runtime gate reports QUALIFIED
f08_pilot.outcome_use: no model or comparator tuning from observed predictive rankings
f08_pilot.stop_rule: complete all scheduled pilot cells unless infrastructure-invalid; no optional stopping on favourable scores

python_runtime.transitive_lock: must be generated once in hosted clean-room acquisition, persisted with wheel SHA-256 values, then installed with --require-hashes semantics

plastic_runtime.preferred_implementation: official CapyMOA-PLASTIC wrapper backed by the official pinned PLASTIC MOA JAR
qualification_required: build pinned MOA JAR from pinned source
record JAR SHA-256 and Java/Maven versions
show a row-level predict-then-train adapter over study source semantics
verify deterministic replay under the same seed/source
plastic_runtime.prohibited: no River approximation, no hand-reimplementation, no vendoring/relicensing of GPL source into the project

upstream_variant_decision.PLASTIC-A: excluded from primary benchmark; background-learner wrapper changes the adaptation mechanism
upstream_variant_decision.EFHAT: excluded from primary benchmark; retained as upstream ablation/context rather than an additional primary nearest-neighbour comparator
upstream_variant_decision.reason: avoid redundant comparator proliferation and post-hoc multiplicity while retaining the closest published method.

process_and_threads.cell_isolation: fresh OS process per method × source × scheduled method seed
process_and_threads.clock_policy: CLOCK_MONOTONIC/perf_counter_ns for elapsed and process CPU clock for CPU; record host and kernel metadata
process_and_threads.cache_policy: no cross-method in-process model reuse; source bytes may remain in OS page cache and run order must be recorded rather than falsely claiming cold-cache equality

resource_measurement.primary_resource_interpretation: implementation-level realised cost under the declared host policy; not FLOP equivalence and not APW equivalence

failure_policy.environment_or_version_mismatch: ENVIRONMENT_INVALID; no scientific record and no fallback
failure_policy.source_integrity_failure: INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID; invalidate affected execution before scientific analysis
failure_policy.algorithm_failure_after_valid_start: ALGORITHMIC_FAILURE; preserve failure point, score every remaining planned prediction slot as 0-1 loss=1, and retain a separate failure indicator/time-to-failure
failure_policy.rss_limit_exceeded_after_valid_start: ALGORITHMIC_FAILURE_RESOURCE_LIMIT under the declared 2048 MiB cap; same post-failure loss=1 rule
failure_policy.timeout: no scientific timeout chosen in F07; F08 may measure runtime but cannot invent a timeout after seeing method rankings
